id.instruksi: Baca judulnya, lalu susun langkah terbentuknya fosil.
id.cangkang-mati: kerang mati dan tenggelam ke dasar laut
id.cangkang-timbun: tertimbun lumpur dan pasir; bagian lunak membusuk, cangkang tertinggal
id.cangkang-tekan: lapisan menumpuk dan menekan jadi batuan sedimen
id.dino-timbun: tubuhnya tertimbun lumpur sungai; daging membusuk, tulang tertinggal
id.dino-tekan: lapisan menumpuk dan menekan jadi batuan sedimen
id.ikan-mati: ikan purba mati dan tenggelam ke dasar danau
id.ikan-timbun: tertutup lumpur halus; bagian lunak membusuk, tulang dan sisik tertinggal
id.ikan-tekan: lapisan lumpur menekan jadi batuan sedimen
id.ikan-sungai: sungai mengikis batuan, fosil ikan terlihat
id.daun-pohon: pohon purba tumbuh di tepi rawa
id.hiu-mati: hiu purba mati dan tenggelam ke dasar laut
id.hiu-timbun: tertimbun pasir dan lumpur; bagian lunak hancur, gigi yang keras tertinggal
id.hiu-tekan: lapisan menumpuk dan menekan jadi batuan sedimen
id.hiu-pantai: ombak mengikis batuan, gigi fosil ditemukan di pantai
id.burung-mati: burung purba mati di tepi danau
id.burung-timbun: tertutup lumpur yang sangat halus; daging membusuk, tulang dan bekas bulu tertinggal
id.burung-tekan: lapisan menumpuk dan menekan jadi batuan sedimen
id.burung-tambang: penambang batu membelah batuan dan menemukannya
id.penyu-mati: penyu purba mati di dasar laut
id.penyu-timbun: tertimbun pasir; bagian lunak membusuk, tempurung dan tulang tertinggal
id.penyu-tekan: lapisan menumpuk dan menekan jadi batuan sedimen
id.penyu-gurun: laut purba itu kini gurun; angin mengikis batuan, fosil tersingkap
id.kayu-timbun: batangnya tertimbun lumpur dan abu gunung api
id.kayu-resap: air berisi mineral meresap ke dalam kayu
id.kayu-ganti: mineral menggantikan kayu sedikit demi sedikit
id.amber-1: siput laut mati di dasar laut dangkal
id.amber-2: cangkangnya tertutup pasir dan lumpur; bagian lunak membusuk, cangkang keras tertinggal
id.amber-4: lapisan pasir menekan jadi batuan sedimen
id.amber-6: batuan terangkat dan terkikis, fosil terlihat
id.mamut-1: gajah purba mati di tepi sungai
id.mamut-2: banjir menimbunnya dengan lumpur; daging membusuk, tulang dan gading tertinggal
id.mamut-4: lapisan lumpur mengeras jadi batuan sedimen
id.mamut-6: penggali menemukan fosilnya di tebing sungai

en.instruksi: Read the title, then put the steps of fossil formation in order.
en.cangkang-mati: a shellfish dies and sinks to the seabed
en.cangkang-timbun: it is buried by mud and sand; the soft parts rot, the shell is left
en.cangkang-tekan: layers pile up and press into sedimentary rock
en.cangkang-tersingkap: the rock wears away and the fossil is uncovered
en.jejak-injak: an animal steps in soft mud
en.jejak-tampak: the rock wears away and the print shows again
en.dino-mati: a dinosaur dies by a river
en.dino-timbun: its body is buried by river mud; the flesh rots and the bones are left
en.dino-tekan: layers pile up and press into sedimentary rock
en.ikan-mati: an ancient fish dies and sinks to the lake floor
en.ikan-timbun: it is covered by fine mud; the soft parts rot; bones and scales are left
en.ikan-tekan: layers of mud press into sedimentary rock
en.ikan-sungai: a river wears the rock away and the fish fossil shows
en.daun-pohon: an ancient tree grows by a swamp
en.daun-gugur: its leaves fall into the swamp water
en.daun-timbun: the leaves are covered by fine mud
en.daun-belah: the rock is split and a leaf print shows
en.hiu-mati: an ancient shark dies and sinks to the sea floor
en.hiu-timbun: it is buried by sand and mud; the soft parts break down; the hard teeth are left
en.hiu-tekan: layers pile up and press into sedimentary rock
en.hiu-pantai: waves wear the rock away and the fossil tooth is found on a beach
en.burung-mati: an ancient bird dies by a lake
en.burung-timbun: it is covered by very fine mud; the flesh rots; bones and feather marks are left
en.burung-tekan: layers pile up and press into sedimentary rock
en.burung-tambang: quarry workers split the rock and find it
en.penyu-mati: an ancient turtle dies on the sea floor
en.penyu-timbun: it is buried by sand; the soft parts rot; the shell and bones are left
en.penyu-tekan: layers pile up and press into sedimentary rock
en.penyu-mineral: minerals replace the shell and bones
en.penyu-gurun: the old sea is now a desert; wind wears the rock and the fossil shows
en.kayu-tumbang: a tree falls into a river
en.kayu-timbun: the trunk is buried by mud and volcanic ash
en.kayu-resap: mineral-rich water soaks into the wood
en.kayu-ganti: minerals replace the wood bit by bit
en.kayu-batu: the wood turns to stone (petrified wood)
en.amber-1: a sea snail dies on the shallow sea floor
en.amber-2: its shell is covered by sand and mud; the soft body rots, the hard shell remains
en.amber-4: layers of sand press down into sedimentary rock
en.amber-6: the rock is lifted and worn away, the fossil shows
en.mamut-1: an ancient elephant dies by a river
en.mamut-2: a flood buries it in mud; the flesh rots, bones and tusks remain
en.mamut-4: the mud layers harden into sedimentary rock
en.mamut-6: diggers find the fossil in the riverbank
